proposed.explanation: Comparing the four companies on net profit and P/E ratio: Telecom Egypt (ETEL) net profit grew from 10,111,328,000 EGP in 2024 to 22,578,063,000 EGP in 2025 with an EPS of 11.93 EGP, giving a P/E of 11.90 based on the share price of 141.95 EGP. CIB (COMI) net profit grew from 55,256,732,000 EGP in 2024 to 82,258,815,000 EGP in 2025 with a basic EPS of 18.25 EGP, giving a P/E of 7.01 based on the share price of 128.00 EGP. Edita (EFID) consolidated net profit grew from 1,606,727,698 EGP in 2024 to 2,695,301,670 EGP in 2025 with an EPS of 2.18 EGP, giving a P/E of 9.36 based on the share price of 20.40 EGP. Talaat Moustafa Group (TMGH) consolidated net profit grew from 12,769,517,325 EGP in 2024 to 18,201,981,482 EGP in 2025 with an EPS of 6.98 EGP, giving a P/E of 11.82 based on the share price of 82.50 EGP. TMGH offers a strong growth profile aligning with the investor's long-term goal. With cash of 80,000.00 EGP, buying 484 shares of TMGH at 82.50 EGP totals 39,930.00 EGP, representing 49.91% of the total portfolio value (80,000.00 EGP cash plus holdings), which complies strictly with the diversification limit of not exceeding half of the portfolio's total value.
